The '''B1E unit''' was a model of [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]]. A B1E [[Droid/Legends|droid]] served aboard the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser]] [[Resolute (Invincible-class)|''Resolute'']] and in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the unit treated the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Reen Irana]] for injuries that she had received after being shot in the chest with a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] blast by the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|But the one that is true Tuckerism is the B1E medical droid, which is named after my wife's long running, now-deceased character in the her game&mdash;Doctor Bunny.|Jeff Grubb, in an interview with [http://roqoodepot.com Roqoo Depot]|<ref name="Roqoo Depot">{{WebCite|url=http://roqoodepot.com/2012/04/24/interview-with-jeff-grubb|text=Roqoo Depot Interview with Jeff Grubb|archivedate=20130601123148}}</ref>}}
The B1E unit was created by [[Jeff Grubb]] and appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]. Grubb intended the B1E to be a [[Tuckerization]] that referenced "Doctor Bunny," a character that was used by his wife in a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] campaign.<ref name="Roqoo Depot" />
